<template>
    <Button
    @click="handleRecording()"
        :class="[
            'bg-transparent rounded-full! p-1! border-none transition-all duration-300',
            isRecording 
                ? 'recording-pulse bg-red-500/10! dark:bg-red-500/20!' 
                : 'hover:bg-primary-500/10! hover:dark:bg-primary-500/20!'
        ]"
    :style="{ width: props.size, height: props.size }"
        >
        <Mic v-if="!isRecording" class=" text-primary-700! dark:text-primary-300!" />
        <MicOff v-else class="text-red-500! animate-pulse" />
    </Button>
</template>
<script setup>
const props = defineProps({
    language: {
        type: String,
        default: 'ar'
    },
    size: {
        type: String,
        default: '44px'
    }
});
const output = defineModel();
const isRecording = ref(false);
const speechEndTimeout = ref(null);
const SILENCE_DURATION = 2000; // 2 seconds

const recognition = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition || window.mozSpeechRecognition || window.msSpeechRecognition)();
recognition.continuous = true;
recognition.interimResults = true;

recognition.onstart = () => {
    isRecording.value = true;
};

recognition.onresult = (event) => {    
    const transcript = event.results[0][0].transcript;
    output.value = transcript;
};
const clearSpeechTimeout = () => {
    if (speechEndTimeout.value) {
        clearTimeout(speechEndTimeout.value);
        speechEndTimeout.value = null;
    }
};

recognition.onspeechstart = () => {
    console.log('speech started');
    clearSpeechTimeout();
};

recognition.onspeechend = () => {
    console.log('speech ended');
    clearSpeechTimeout();
    speechEndTimeout.value = setTimeout(() => {
        if (isRecording.value) {
            console.log('speech ended and timeout');
            handleRecording();
        }
    }, SILENCE_DURATION);
};
const handleRecording = () => {
    recognition.lang = props.language;
    if (isRecording.value) {
        recognition.stop();
        clearSpeechTimeout();
    } else {
        recognition.start();
    }
    isRecording.value = !isRecording.value;
};

</script>
<style scoped>
@keyframes recording-pulse {
    0%, 100% {
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);
    }
    50% {
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0);
    }
}

.recording-pulse {
    animation: recording-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}
</style>

<script setup>
import {
    Room,
    RoomEvent
} from 'livekit-client';

import ParticipantTile from './components/ParticipantTile.vue';
import AudioComponent from './components/AudioComponent.vue';
import ChatComponent from './components/ChatComponent.vue';
import RightSidebar from './components/RightSidebar.vue';
import AttendanceSidebar from './components/AttendanceSidebar.vue';
import ResourcesComponent from './components/ResourcesComponent.vue';
import PollsComponent from './components/PollsComponent.vue';
import SharedNotesComponent from './components/SharedNotesComponent.vue';
import PdfViewer from './components/PdfViewer.vue';
import AnnotationCanvas from './components/AnnotationCanvas.vue';
import WhiteboardToolbar from './components/WhiteboardToolbar.vue';

import { Maximize, Minimize, PenTool, Hand, X } from 'lucide-vue-next';

import { useRoute } from 'vue-router';
import { useBaseStore } from '@/stores/baseStore';
import { useCourseAttendanceStore } from '@/projects/sis/stores/courseAttendanceStore';
import { apiPost, apiGet } from '@/utilities/fetchApi';

// ==============================================================
// Dynamic lecture info
// ==============================================================
const route = useRoute();
const meetingId = computed(() => route.params.meetingId);

const lectureInfo = ref({
    courseName: 'جاري التحميل...',
    teacherName: '',
    taboor: '',
});
const courseDetailsForAttendance = ref(null);

// ==============================================================
// URLs
// ==============================================================
let LIVEKIT_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_LIVEKIT_WS_URL || 'wss://www.isd-sis.mil/livekit-server/';
configureUrls();

function configureUrls() {
    if (!LIVEKIT_URL) {
        LIVEKIT_URL = window.location.hostname === 'localhost'
            ? 'ws://localhost:7880/'
            : 'wss://' + window.location.hostname + ':7443/';
    }
}

// ==============================================================
// State
// ==============================================================
const room        = shallowRef();
const remoteParticipants = shallowRef(new Map());
const layoutTrigger = ref(0);

function syncRemoteParticipants() {
    if (!room.value) return;
    const next = new Map();
    room.value.remoteParticipants.forEach((p) => next.set(p.identity, p));
    remoteParticipants.value = next;
    syncRaisedHandsWithParticipants();
    layoutTrigger.value++;
}

let participantName = ref('');
let roomName        = ref('');
const isCreator     = ref(false);
// Initialize to true if we're on a route that will auto-join
const isAutoJoining = ref(
    !!route.params.meetingId || 
    (new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).has('Participant') && new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).has('Room'))
);
const showDebug     = ref(false);
const debugLastMetadata = ref('');
const debugLastError    = ref('');

const debugParticipants = computed(() => {
    layoutTrigger.value;
    const parts = [];
    if (room.value) {
        if (room.value.localParticipant) {
            parts.push({ id: room.value.localParticipant.identity + ' (Local)', hasCam: room.value.localParticipant.isCameraEnabled, hasScreen: room.value.localParticipant.isScreenShareEnabled });
        }
        for (const p of remoteParticipants.value.values()) {
            parts.push({ id: p.identity, hasCam: p.isCameraEnabled, hasScreen: p.isScreenShareEnabled });
        }
    }
    return parts;
});

const roomCreators        = new Map();
const mainStageSelection  = ref(null);
const remoteFocusTarget   = ref(null);

// Chat
const showChat        = ref(false);
const chatMessages    = ref([]);
const unreadChatCount = ref(0);
const showParticipantsPanel = ref(true);
const showWhiteboardToolbar = ref(true);
const raisedHands = ref({});
const localHandRaised = ref(false);

const isFullscreen = ref(false);
const roomContainerRef = ref(null);

const toggleWhiteboardToolbar = () => {
    showWhiteboardToolbar.value = !showWhiteboardToolbar.value;
    console.log('Whiteboard Toolbar Toggle:', showWhiteboardToolbar.value);
};

const toggleFullscreen = () => {
    if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
        if (roomContainerRef.value) {
            roomContainerRef.value.requestFullscreen().catch(err => {
                console.warn(`Error attempting to enable fullscreen: ${err.message}`);
            });
        }
    } else {
        if (document.exitFullscreen) {
            document.exitFullscreen();
        }
    }
};

// Attendance (left sidebar)
const showAttendance = ref(false);

// Resources / Polls
const showResources = ref(false);
const showPolls     = ref(false);
const activePoll    = ref(null);
const pollVotes     = ref({});

// Shared Notes state
const showSharedNotes = ref(false);
const localNotesContent = ref('');
const pinnedNotesContent = ref('');
const isSharedNotesPinned = ref(false);
const activeNotesPresenter = ref(null);
const notesShareRequests = ref([]);
let notesSyncTimeout = null;

// Shared file on main stage
const sharedFile = ref(null); // { docId, name, mimeType, blobUrl, fileType: 'pdf'|'image' }
let   sharedFileBlobUrl = null;
const sharedFilePage = ref(1);
const sharedFileZoom = ref(1.0);
const sharedFileTotalPages = ref(0);

// Annotation state
const annotationTool = ref('pointer');
const annotationColor = ref('#ef4444');
const annotationWidth = ref(3);
const allAnnotations = ref({}); // { [pageKey]: [strokes] }

const currentAnnotationPageKey = computed(() => {
    if (isSharedNotesPinned.value) return 'notes';
    if (sharedFile.value) {
        if (sharedFile.value.fileType === 'pdf') {
            return `pdf-${sharedFile.value.docId}-${sharedFilePage.value}`;
        }
        return `img-${sharedFile.value.docId}`;
    }
    if (creatorMainStageTile.value && creatorMainStageTile.value.isScreenShare) return 'screen';
    return 'camera';
});

// Room settings (teacher-controlled)
const roomSettings = ref({ 
    studentsCanSeeResources: true
});
const showSettingsPopover = ref(false);
const settingsBtnRef = ref(null);

// Session timer
const sessionSeconds = ref(0);
let timerInterval = null;

const sessionTime = computed(() => {
    const h = Math.floor(sessionSeconds.value / 3600).toString().padStart(2, '0');
    const m = Math.floor((sessionSeconds.value % 3600) / 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
    const s = (sessionSeconds.value % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
    return `${h}:${m}:${s}`;
});

// ==============================================================
// Tiles computation (unchanged logic)
// ==============================================================
const tiles = computed(() => {
    layoutTrigger.value;
    const t = [];
    if (!room.value) return t;

    const allParticipants = [];
    const localP = room.value.localParticipant;
    let localCamTrack, localScreenTrack;

    localP.videoTrackPublications.forEach((pub) => {
        if (pub.source === 'camera' && pub.track) localCamTrack = pub.track;
        if (pub.source === 'screen_share' && pub.track) localScreenTrack = pub.track;
    });

    allParticipants.push({ participant: localP, identity: localP.identity, isLocal: true, camTrack: localCamTrack, screenTrack: localScreenTrack });

    remoteParticipants.value.forEach((p) => {
        let remoteCamTrack, remoteScreenTrack;
        p.videoTrackPublications.forEach((pub) => {
            if (pub.source === 'camera' && pub.track) remoteCamTrack = pub.track;
            if (pub.source === 'screen_share' && pub.track) remoteScreenTrack = pub.track;
        });
        allParticipants.push({ participant: p, identity: p.identity, isLocal: false, camTrack: remoteCamTrack, screenTrack: remoteScreenTrack });
    });

    if (isCreator.value) {
        let mainStagePart, mainStageType = 'camera';

        if (mainStageSelection.value) {
            const selected = allParticipants.find(p => p.identity === mainStageSelection.value.identity);
            if (selected) {
                const wantedType = mainStageSelection.value.type;
                if (wantedType === 'screen' && selected.screenTrack)       { mainStagePart = selected; mainStageType = 'screen'; }
                else if (wantedType === 'camera' && selected.camTrack)     { mainStagePart = selected; mainStageType = 'camera'; }
                else if (selected.screenTrack)                              { mainStagePart = selected; mainStageType = 'screen'; }
                else if (selected.camTrack)                                 { mainStagePart = selected; mainStageType = 'camera'; }
            }
        }

        if (!mainStagePart) {
            const localData = allParticipants.find(p => p.isLocal);
            if (localData) {
                if (localData.screenTrack)      { mainStagePart = localData; mainStageType = 'screen'; }
                else if (localData.camTrack)    { mainStagePart = localData; mainStageType = 'camera'; }
            }
        }

        if (mainStagePart) {
            t.push({ id: mainStagePart.identity + '-main-' + mainStageType, participant: mainStagePart.participant, track: mainStageType === 'screen' ? mainStagePart.screenTrack : mainStagePart.camTrack, isLocal: mainStagePart.isLocal, identity: mainStagePart.identity + (mainStageType === 'screen' ? ' (Screen)' : ''), isScreenShare: mainStageType === 'screen', isCreatorMainStage: true, participantIdentity: mainStagePart.identity, contentType: mainStageType, isMicEnabled: mainStagePart.participant.isMicrophoneEnabled });

' (Screen)' : ''), isScreenShare: mainStageType === 'screen', isCreatorMainStage: true, participantIdentity: mainStagePart.identity, contentType: mainStageType, isMicEnabled: mainStagePart.participant.isMicrophoneEnabled });

const participantTiles     = computed(() => {
    const visibleTiles = tiles.value.filter(t => !t.isCreatorMainStage);
    return visibleTiles
        .map((tile, index) => ({
            tile,
            index,
            raisedAt: raisedHands.value[tile.participantIdentity]?.raisedAt ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,
        }))
        .sort((a, b) => {
            const aRaised = a.raisedAt !== Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
            const bRaised = b.raisedAt !== Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;

            if (aRaised !== bRaised) return aRaised ? -1 : 1;
            if (aRaised && bRaised && a.raisedAt !== b.raisedAt) return a.raisedAt - b.raisedAt;
            return a.index - b.index;
        })
        .map(entry => entry.tile);
});

// Total participant count (local + remote)

    layoutTrigger.value;
    if (!room.value) return 0;
    return 1 + remoteParticipants.value.size;
});

const raisedHandCount = computed(() => Object.keys(raisedHands.value).length);

function participantHasRaisedHand(identity) {
    return !!raisedHands.value[identity];
}

function applyRaisedHand(identity, payload = {}) {
    if (!identity) return;

    const current = raisedHands.value[identity] || {};
    raisedHands.value = {
        ...raisedHands.value,
        [identity]: {
            identity,
            name: payload.name || current.name || identity,
            raisedAt: payload.raisedAt || current.raisedAt || Date.now(),
        },
    };

    if (room.value?.localParticipant?.identity === identity) {
        localHandRaised.value = true;
    }
}

function clearRaisedHand(identity) {
    if (!identity || !raisedHands.value[identity]) return;

    const next = { ...raisedHands.value };
    delete next[identity];
    raisedHands.value = next;

    if (room.value?.localParticipant?.identity === identity) {
        localHandRaised.value = false;
    }
}

function syncRaisedHandsWithParticipants() {
    if (!room.value?.localParticipant) {
        raisedHands.value = {};
        localHandRaised.value = false;
        return;
    }

    const validIdentities = new Set([
        room.value.localParticipant.identity,
        ...remoteParticipants.value.keys(),
    ]);

    raisedHands.value = Object.fromEntries(
        Object.entries(raisedHands.value).filter(([identity]) => validIdentities.has(identity))
    );
    localHandRaised.value = !!raisedHands.value[room.value.localParticipant.identity];
}

async function joinRoom() {
    room.value = new Room();

    room.value.on(RoomEvent.ParticipantConnected, (participant) => {
        syncRemoteParticipants();
        if (localHandRaised.value && room.value?.localParticipant?.identity) {
            publishRoomData({
                type: 'HAND_RAISED',
                identity: room.value.localParticipant.identity,
                name: participantName.value,
                raisedAt: raisedHands.value[room.value.localParticipant.identity]?.raisedAt || Date.now(),
            }, [participant.identity]);
        }
        if (isCreator.value) {
            broadcastState([participant.identity]);
            // Broadcast current settings to new participant
            publishRoomData({ type: 'SETTINGS_UPDATE', settings: { ...roomSettings.value } });
            // Broadcast active shared file to new participant
            if (sharedFile.value) {
                const sf = sharedFile.value;
                const data = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify({ type: 'FILE_SHARE', docId: sf.docId, name: sf.name, mimeType: sf.mimeType, fileType: sf.fileType }));
                room.value.localParticipant.publishData(data, { reliable: true, destinationIdentities: [participant.identity] });
            }
            if (activePoll.value?.status === 'open') {
                const plainPoll = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(activePoll.value));
                publishPollData({ type: 'POLL_CREATED', poll: plainPoll }, [participant.identity]);
                publishPollData({ type: 'POLL_SYNC_VOTES', votes: { ...pollVotes.value } }, [participant.identity]);
            }
            if (sharedNotesContent.value) {
                const data = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify({ type: 'SHARED_NOTES_UPDATE', html: sharedNotesContent.value }));
                room.value.localParticipant.publishData(data, { reliable: true, destinationIdentities: [participant.identity] });
            }
            if (isSharedNotesPinned.value) {
                const data = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify({ type: 'SHARED_NOTES_PIN' }));
                room.value.localParticipant.publishData(data, { reliable: true, destinationIdentities: [participant.identity] });
            }
        }
    });

    room.value.on(RoomEvent.DataReceived, (payload, participant) => {
        const strData = new TextDecoder().decode(payload);
        debugLastMetadata.value = `Data from ${participant?.identity || 'Server'}: ${strData}`;
        handleDataMessage(strData, participant);
    });

    room.value.on(RoomEvent.ParticipantDisconnected, () => syncRemoteParticipants());
    room.value.on(RoomEvent.TrackPublished,          () => syncRemoteParticipants());
    room.value.on(RoomEvent.TrackUnpublished,        () => syncRemoteParticipants());
    room.value.on(RoomEvent.TrackSubscribed,         () => syncRemoteParticipants());
    room.value.on(RoomEvent.TrackUnsubscribed,       () => syncRemoteParticipants());
    room.value.on(RoomEvent.TrackMuted,              () => syncRemoteParticipants());
    room.value.on(RoomEvent.TrackUnmuted,            () => syncRemoteParticipants());
    room.value.on(RoomEvent.LocalTrackPublished,     () => { room.value = room.value; layoutTrigger.value++; });
    room.value.on(RoomEvent.LocalTrackUnpublished,   () => { room.value = room.value; layoutTrigger.value++; });
    room.value.on(RoomEvent.LocalTrackMuted,         () => { layoutTrigger.value++; });
    room.value.on(RoomEvent.LocalTrackUnmuted,       () => { layoutTrigger.value++; });

    try {
        const tokenResponse = await getToken(meetingId.value);
        
        participantName.value = tokenResponse.participantName;
        isCreator.value = tokenResponse.personType === 'Instructor';

        if (isCreator.value) roomCreators.set(roomName.value, participantName.value);

        await room.value.connect(LIVEKIT_URL, tokenResponse.token);
        syncRemoteParticipants();
        if (isCreator.value && room.value.localParticipant) broadcastState();
        // Start timer
        timerInterval = setInterval(() => sessionSeconds.value++, 1000);
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error connecting to room:', error.message);
        await leaveRoom();
    }

    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', leaveRoom);
}

async function leaveRoom() {
    clearInterval(timerInterval);
    timerInterval = null;
    sessionSeconds.value = 0;
    await room.value?.disconnect();
    room.value = undefined;
    remoteParticipants.value = new Map();
    raisedHands.value = {};
    localHandRaised.value = false;
    layoutTrigger.value++;
    isCreator.value = false;
    mainStageSelection.value = null;
    window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', leaveRoom);
}

// Data messaging
// ==============================================================
function handleDataMessage(dataStr, participant) {
    try {
        const data = JSON.parse(dataStr);

        if (data.type === 'CHAT') {
            const isLocal = data.senderIdentity === room.value?.localParticipant.identity;
            chatMessages.value.push({ sender: data.senderName, text: data.text, timestamp: data.timestamp, isLocal });
            if (!showChat.value && !isLocal) unreadChatCount.value++;
            return;
        }

        if (data.type === 'HAND_RAISED') {
            applyRaisedHand(data.identity || participant?.identity, data);
            return;
        }

        if (data.type === 'HAND_LOWERED') {
            clearRaisedHand(data.identity || participant?.identity);
            return;
        }

        if (data.isCreator && participant) roomCreators.set(roomName.value, participant.identity);

        if (data.type === 'STATE_UPDATE' && data.focusTarget !== undefined) {
            remoteFocusTarget.value = data.focusTarget;
            layoutTrigger.value++;
        }

        if (data.type === 'POLL_CREATED')   { activePoll.value = data.poll; pollVotes.value = {}; showPolls.value = true; }
        if (data.type === 'POLL_VOTE')      { const idx = data.optionIndex; if (pollVotes.value[idx] === undefined) pollVotes.value[idx] = 0; pollVotes.value[idx]++; }
        if (data.type === 'POLL_ENDED')     { if (activePoll.value) activePoll.value.status = 'closed'; }
        if (data.type === 'POLL_SYNC_VOTES') pollVotes.value = data.votes;

        if (data.type === 'FILE_SHARE') {
            // Fetch file blob as this participant to render locally
            loadSharedFile(data.docId, data.mimeType, data.name, data.fileType);
            sharedFilePage.value = 1;
            sharedFileZoom.value = 1.0;
        }
        if (data.type === 'FILE_SHARE_STOP') {
            clearSharedFile();
        }
        if (data.type === 'FILE_SYNC') {
            sharedFilePage.value = data.page;
            sharedFileZoom.value = data.zoom;
        }
        if (data.type === 'SETTINGS_UPDATE' && data.settings) {
            roomSettings.value = data.settings;
        }

        if (data.type === 'SHARED_NOTES_UPDATE') {
            if (isSharedNotesPinned.value && activeNotesPresenter.value === data.presenterIdentity) {
                pinnedNotesContent.value = data.html || '';
            }
        }
        if (data.type === 'SHARED_NOTES_PIN') {
            isSharedNotesPinned.value = true;
            activeNotesPresenter.value = data.presenterIdentity;
            pinnedNotesContent.value = data.html || '';
        }
        if (data.type === 'SHARED_NOTES_UNPIN') {
            isSharedNotesPinned.value = false;
            activeNotesPresenter.value = null;
        }
        if (data.type === 'SHARED_NOTES_SHARE_REQUEST') {
            if (isCreator.value && data.identity) {
                if (!notesShareRequests.value.some(r => r.identity === data.identity)) {
                    notesShareRequests.value.push({ identity: data.identity, name: data.name, html: data.html });
                }
            }
        }

        // Annotation sync
        if (data.type === 'ANNOTATION_STROKE') {
            if (!allAnnotations.value[data.pageKey]) allAnnotations.value[data.pageKey] = [];
            allAnnotations.value[data.pageKey].push(data.stroke);
        }
        if (data.type === 'ANNOTATION_CLEAR') {
            allAnnotations.value[data.pageKey] = [];
        }
        if (data.type === 'ANNOTATION_UNDO') {
            if (allAnnotations.value[data.pageKey]) allAnnotations.value[data.pageKey].pop();
        }

    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Data parsing error:', e);
        debugLastError.value = `Data Parse Error: ${e?.message}`;
    }
}

async function broadcastState(destinationIdentities = []) {
    if (!room.value?.localParticipant || !isCreator.value) return;
    try {
        const payload = { type: 'STATE_UPDATE', isCreator: true, focusTarget: mainStageSelection.value };
        const data = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(payload));
        const ids = Array.isArray(destinationIdentities) ? destinationIdentities : [destinationIdentities];
        await room.value.localParticipant.publishData(data, { reliable: true, destinationIdentities: ids.filter(Boolean) });
        debugLastError.value = 'State Broadcast Success';
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Failed to broadcast state:', e);
        debugLastError.value = `Broadcast Error: ${e.message}`;
    }
}

async function loadSharedFile(docId, mimeType, name, fileType) {
    try {
        const response = await apiGet(`/sis_api/Document/GetFile/${docId}`, { responseType: 'blob' });
        const rawData = response?.data;
        
        let fileUrl = null;
        if (rawData instanceof Blob && (rawData.type === 'application/json' || rawData.size < 4000)) {
            try {
                const text = await rawData.text();
                const jsonObj = JSON.parse(text);
                if (jsonObj && jsonObj.fileUrl) {
                    fileUrl = jsonObj.fileUrl;
                }
            } catch (jsonErr) {
                // Not JSON, continue to treat as binary blob
            }
        }

        if (sharedFileBlobUrl && sharedFileBlobUrl.startsWith('blob:')) {
            URL.revokeObjectURL(sharedFileBlobUrl);
        }

        if (fileUrl) {
            sharedFileBlobUrl = fileUrl;
        } else {
            const blob = rawData instanceof Blob
                ? rawData
                : new Blob([rawData ?? []], { type: mimeType ?? 'application/octet-stream' });
            sharedFileBlobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        }
        
        sharedFile.value = { docId, name, mimeType, blobUrl: sharedFileBlobUrl, fileType };
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Failed to load shared file:', e);
    }
}

function clearSharedFile() {
    if (sharedFileBlobUrl && sharedFileBlobUrl.startsWith('blob:')) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(sharedFileBlobUrl);
    }
    sharedFileBlobUrl = null;
    sharedFile.value = null;
}

function handleShareFile(fileData) {
    // Teacher sets local state immediately
    if (sharedFileBlobUrl && sharedFileBlobUrl.startsWith('blob:')) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(sharedFileBlobUrl);
    }
    sharedFileBlobUrl = null; // Teacher's blob is already in fileData.blobUrl - don't revoke that here
    sharedFile.value = fileData;
    // Broadcast doc ID (not blob URL) to all participants
    publishRoomData({ type: 'FILE_SHARE', docId: fileData.docId, name: fileData.name, mimeType: fileData.mimeType, fileType: fileData.fileType });
}

function handleStopSharingFile() {
    clearSharedFile();
    publishRoomData({ type: 'FILE_SHARE_STOP' });
}

async function publishRoomData(payload, destinationIdentities = []) {

        const options = destinationIdentities.length
            ? { reliable: true, destinationIdentities }
            : { reliable: true };
        await room.value.localParticipant.publishData(data, options);
    } catch (e) { console.error('Failed to publish room data:', e); }
}

// ── Shared Notes functions ──────────────────────────────────────────────
function handleSharedNotesUpdate(newHtml) {
    localNotesContent.value = newHtml;
    
    // Broadcast if I am the active presenter
    if (activeNotesPresenter.value === room.value?.localParticipant?.identity) {
        // Also update local pinned view instantly
        pinnedNotesContent.value = newHtml;
        clearTimeout(notesSyncTimeout);
        notesSyncTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            publishRoomData({ type: 'SHARED_NOTES_UPDATE', presenterIdentity: activeNotesPresenter.value, html: newHtml });
        }, 400); // 400ms debounce
    }
}

function handleToggleNotesPin() {
    if (!room.value?.localParticipant) return;
    const myId = room.value.localParticipant.identity;
    
    // If I am currently pinned, stop
    if (isSharedNotesPinned.value && activeNotesPresenter.value === myId) {
        handleStopPinnedNotes();
    } else {
        // I am starting to present my local notes
        isSharedNotesPinned.value = true;
        activeNotesPresenter.value = myId;
        pinnedNotesContent.value = localNotesContent.value;
        publishRoomData({ type: 'SHARED_NOTES_PIN', presenterIdentity: myId, html: localNotesContent.value });
    }
}

function handleStopPinnedNotes() {
    isSharedNotesPinned.value = false;
    activeNotesPresenter.value = null;
    publishRoomData({ type: 'SHARED_NOTES_UNPIN' });
}

function handleRequestNoteShare() {
    if (!room.value?.localParticipant || isCreator.value) return;
    const payload = { type: 'SHARED_NOTES_SHARE_REQUEST', identity: room.value.localParticipant.identity, name: participantName.value, html: localNotesContent.value };
    publishRoomData(payload);
}

function handleApproveNoteShare(studentIdentity, studentHtml) {
    if (!isCreator.value) return;
    notesShareRequests.value = notesShareRequests.value.filter(r => r.identity !== studentIdentity);
    isSharedNotesPinned.value = true;
    activeNotesPresenter.value = studentIdentity;
    pinnedNotesContent.value = studentHtml || '<p>جاري تحميل الملاحظات...</p>';
    publishRoomData({ type: 'SHARED_NOTES_PIN', presenterIdentity: studentIdentity, html: pinnedNotesContent.value });
}

function handleRejectNoteShare(studentIdentity) {
    notesShareRequests.value = notesShareRequests.value.filter(r => r.identity !== studentIdentity);
}

// ── Polls ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function publishPollData(payload, destinationIdentities = []) {
    if (!room.value?.localParticipant) return;
    try {
        const data = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(payload));
        await room.value.localParticipant.publishData(data, { reliable: true, destinationIdentities });
    } catch (e) { console.error('Failed to publish poll data:', e); }
}

function handleCreatePoll(pollData) {
    const newPoll = { id: Date.now().toString(), question: pollData.question, options: pollData.options, status: 'open', createdAt: Date.now(), duration: pollData.duration };
    activePoll.value = newPoll;
    pollVotes.value = {};
    publishPollData({ type: 'POLL_CREATED', poll: newPoll });
}

function handleVote(optionIndex) {
    publishPollData({ type: 'POLL_VOTE', optionIndex });
    if (pollVotes.value[optionIndex] === undefined) pollVotes.value[optionIndex] = 0;
    pollVotes.value[optionIndex]++;
}

function handleEndPoll() {
    if (activePoll.value) {
        activePoll.value.status = 'closed';
        publishPollData({ type: 'POLL_ENDED' });
    }
}

onMounted(async () => {
    document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', () => {
        isFullscreen.value = !!document.fullscreenElement;
    });

    const baseStore = useBaseStore();
    const user = baseStore.user || JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user'));
    
    if (meetingId.value) {
        // We have a meetingId from the URL (navigated from lecture schedule)
        const courseAttendanceStore = useCourseAttendanceStore();
        
        try {
            const details = await courseAttendanceStore.getCourseAttendanceDetails(meetingId.value);
            if (details) {
                lectureInfo.value = {
                    courseName: details.courseName || '',
                    teacherName: details.instructorName || '',
                    taboor: details.periodName || '',
                };
                courseDetailsForAttendance.value = details;
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error("Failed to load attendance details:", e);
        }

        // Set participant name from logged user
        participantName.value = user?.fullName || user?.userName || 'مشارك';
        
        // Room name = meetingId for uniqueness
        roomName.value = `meeting-${meetingId.value}`;
        
        // Auto-join
        await joinRoom();
    } else {
        // Fallback for direct URL access without meetingId
        const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        if (params.has('Participant') && params.has('Room')) {
            participantName.value = params.get('Participant');
            roomName.value = params.get('Room');
            meetingId.value = params.get('Room').replace('meeting-', '');
            await joinRoom();
        }
    }
});

onUnmounted(() => {
    leaveRoom();
});

<template>
    <canvas 
        ref="canvasRef" 
        class="annotation-canvas"
        :class="{ 'is-interactive': isPresenter && activeTool !== 'pointer' }"
        @mousedown="startDrawing"
        @mousemove="draw"
        @mouseup="stopDrawing"
        @mouseleave="stopDrawing"
        @touchstart="startDrawingTouch"
        @touchmove="drawTouch"
        @touchend="stopDrawing"
    ></canvas>

<script setup>
import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted, watch } from 'vue';

const props = defineProps({
    isPresenter: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    activeTool: { type: String, default: 'pointer' },
    activeColor: { type: String, default: '#ef4444' },
    strokeWidth: { type: Number, default: 3 },
    strokes: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    pageKey: { type: String, required: true }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['stroke-complete']);

const canvasRef = ref(null);
let ctx = null;

const isDrawing = ref(false);
let currentStroke = null;
let canvasRect = null;
let resizeObserver = null;

onMounted(() => {
    initCanvas();
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    
    // Watch parent element size changes
    if (canvasRef.value && canvasRef.value.parentElement) {
        resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
            handleResize();
        });
        resizeObserver.observe(canvasRef.value.parentElement);
    }
});

onUnmounted(() => {
    window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    if (resizeObserver) {
        resizeObserver.disconnect();
    }
});

function initCanvas() {
    if (!canvasRef.value) return;
    const canvas = canvasRef.value;
    const parent = canvas.parentElement;
    
    if (parent) {
        // High DPI support can be added if needed, but for annotations matching CSS pixels is usually fine
        canvas.width = parent.clientWidth;
        canvas.height = parent.clientHeight;
    }
    
    ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    
    canvasRect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    redrawAll();
}

function handleResize() {
    // Debounce or just re-init
    initCanvas();
}

// Watch for incoming strokes from others or page swaps
watch(() => props.strokes, () => {
    redrawAll();
}, { deep: true });

function getEventCoords(e) {
    // Always read fresh bounding rect — prevents drift after resize/scroll/sidebar changes
    canvasRect = canvasRef.value.getBoundingClientRect();
    const clientX = e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX;
    const clientY = e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientY : e.clientY;
    
    const x = clientX - canvasRect.left;
    const y = clientY - canvasRect.top;
    
    // Normalize coordinates (0.0 to 1.0)
    return [
        Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x / canvasRef.value.width)),
        Math.max(0, Math.min(1, y / canvasRef.value.height))
    ];
}

function startDrawing(e) {
    if (!props.isPresenter || props.activeTool === 'pointer') return;
    isDrawing.value = true;
    
    const [nx, ny] = getEventCoords(e);
    
    currentStroke = {
        type: props.activeTool,
        color: props.activeColor,
        width: props.strokeWidth,
        points: [[nx, ny]],
        pageKey: props.pageKey
    };
    
    // Draw initial dot for pen/eraser
    if (props.activeTool === 'pen' || props.activeTool === 'eraser') {
        ctx.beginPath();
        if (props.activeTool === 'eraser') {
            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out';
            ctx.lineWidth = currentStroke.width * 4;
        } else {
            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
            ctx.strokeStyle = currentStroke.color;
            ctx.lineWidth = currentStroke.width;
        }
        
        const px = nx * canvasRef.value.width;
        const py = ny * canvasRef.value.height;
        ctx.moveTo(px, py);
        ctx.lineTo(px, py);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    }
}

function draw(e) {
    if (!isDrawing.value || !currentStroke) return;
    
    const [nx, ny] = getEventCoords(e);
    
    if (props.activeTool === 'pen' || props.activeTool === 'eraser') {
        currentStroke.points.push([nx, ny]);
        
        const lastPt = currentStroke.points[currentStroke.points.length - 2];
        const px1 = lastPt[0] * canvasRef.value.width;
        const py1 = lastPt[1] * canvasRef.value.height;
        const px2 = nx * canvasRef.value.width;
        const py2 = ny * canvasRef.value.height;
        
        ctx.beginPath();
        if (props.activeTool === 'eraser') {
            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out';
            ctx.lineWidth = props.strokeWidth * 4;
        } else {
            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
            ctx.strokeStyle = currentStroke.color;
            ctx.lineWidth = currentStroke.width;
        }
        ctx.moveTo(px1, py1);
        ctx.lineTo(px2, py2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    } else {
        // Shapes
        if (currentStroke.points.length === 1) {
            currentStroke.points.push([nx, ny]);
        } else {
            currentStroke.points[1] = [nx, ny];
        }
        redrawAll();
        drawStroke(currentStroke, ctx, canvasRef.value.width, canvasRef.value.height);
    }
}

function stopDrawing() {
    if (!isDrawing.value || !currentStroke) return;
    isDrawing.value = false;
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    
    // Emit completed stroke so parent can broadcast it and save it
    if (currentStroke.points.length > 1 || props.activeTool === 'text') {

    }

    redrawAll();
}

function startDrawingTouch(e) {
    if (!props.isPresenter || props.activeTool === 'pointer') return;
    // Don't prevent default if pointer, to allow scrolling
    e.preventDefault(); 
    startDrawing(e);
}

function drawTouch(e) {
    if (!props.isPresenter || props.activeTool === 'pointer' || !isDrawing.value) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    draw(e);
}

function redrawAll() {
    if (!ctx || !canvasRef.value) return;
    const w = canvasRef.value.width;
    const h = canvasRef.value.height;
    
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    
    for (const stroke of props.strokes) {
        if (stroke.pageKey === props.pageKey) {
            drawStroke(stroke, ctx, w, h);
        }
    }

function drawStroke(stroke, context, w, h) {
    if (!stroke.points || stroke.points.length < 2) return;
    
    context.beginPath();
    context.lineCap = 'round';
    context.lineJoin = 'round';
    
    if (stroke.type === 'eraser') {
        context.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out';
        context.lineWidth = stroke.width * 4;
    } else {
        context.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
        context.strokeStyle = stroke.color;
        context.lineWidth = stroke.width;
    }
    
    if (stroke.type === 'pen' || stroke.type === 'eraser') {
        const first = stroke.points[0];
        context.moveTo(first[0] * w, first[1] * h);
        for (let i = 1; i < stroke.points.length; i++) {
            const pt = stroke.points[i];
            context.lineTo(pt[0] * w, pt[1] * h);
        }
    } else if (stroke.type === 'line') {
        const p1 = stroke.points[0];
        const p2 = stroke.points[1];
        context.moveTo(p1[0] * w, p1[1] * h);
        context.lineTo(p2[0] * w, p2[1] * h);
    } else if (stroke.type === 'rect') {
        const p1 = stroke.points[0];
        const p2 = stroke.points[1];
        const rx = Math.min(p1[0], p2[0]) * w;
        const ry = Math.min(p1[1], p2[1]) * h;
        const rw = Math.abs(p2[0] - p1[0]) * w;
        const rh = Math.abs(p2[1] - p1[1]) * h;
        context.strokeRect(rx, ry, rw, rh);
    } else if (stroke.type === 'circle') {
        const p1 = stroke.points[0];
        const p2 = stroke.points[1];
        const cx = (p1[0] + p2[0]) / 2 * w;
        const cy = (p1[1] + p2[1]) / 2 * h;
        const rx = Math.abs(p2[0] - p1[0]) / 2 * w;
        const ry = Math.abs(p2[1] - p1[1]) / 2 * h;
        context.ellipse(cx, cy, rx, ry, 0, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    } else if (stroke.type === 'arrow') {
        const p1 = stroke.points[0];
        const p2 = stroke.points[1];
        const x1 = p1[0] * w, y1 = p1[1] * h;
        const x2 = p2[0] * w, y2 = p2[1] * h;
        context.moveTo(x1, y1);
        context.lineTo(x2, y2);
        
        // Draw arrowhead
        const angle = Math.atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1);
        const headlen = 15;
        context.lineTo(x2 - headlen * Math.cos(angle - Math.PI / 6), y2 - headlen * Math.sin(angle - Math.PI / 6));
        context.moveTo(x2, y2);
        context.lineTo(x2 - headlen * Math.cos(angle + Math.PI / 6), y2 - headlen * Math.sin(angle + Math.PI / 6));
    }
    
    context.stroke();
    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
}
</script>
